name: b1x-init-test
source: written by work package B1X to match USINE V3.5's shipped example inputs/init.TEST.par (Model1DKisoVc, run with 'usine -l', USINE's own inputs read in place): its K line with a high break (Rbreak, Deltabreak, sbreak; delta_above = delta - Deltabreak), Va, Vc, geometry with rhole, ISM densities, losses, decay with electron capture, its cross-section files and its NormList (data file crdata_crdb20170523.dat), source slope alpha and eta_s. Not translated, because they do not change B/C: antinuclei and their tertiaries, the hydrogen slope alpha_H = 2.3 (one shared slope here), the second data file crdata_dummy.dat, the NormList elements above Si (outside the network [1H,30Si]) and the display settings. Numbers copied from the shipped file as parameters, no file content.

gas.model: uniform in the thin disc, n_HI = 0.867 cm^-3, n_HII = 0.033 cm^-3, n_H2 = 0 cm^-3

cross_sections.ghost_threshold: USINE chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97 (ghosts folded into cumulative cross sections)

transport.family: BIG (USINE's shipped example, a high break only)
